verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the cartoon visual style, exact slogan text, and stamped-on-meat presentation for this illustration.
First concrete failure: the reviewed design did not show the slogan stamped onto the meat as intended.
The client changes concrete visual acceptance conditions for the tortillas, steak-streak placement, and stamped-text appearance; no obsolete state key requires removal.
Distinct reviewed defects are reported: incorrect tortilla appearance, steak streaks overlapping the text, and insufficient stamped-text appearance.
